column1: # Parity of the protocol capability set across the four surfaces (ADR-014).
# One row per capability; a cell names the RPC / tool / method that serves it, or `-`.
# `reason` is mandatory on a row with `-` in proto, mcp_grpc, mcp_embedded or facade. `api` is the versioned subset (ADR-004).
# Target: zero rows with a reason. The parity test fails when this file and the code disagree in either direction.
# The test is crates/made-mcp/src/protocol/parity_tests.rs; facade methods that are variants of a row are mapped there, never ignored.

column7: decided in F1: no facade method; analysing a draft is a pure domain call (ProtocolDraft::analyze) the adapter makes directly, and made-api exposes it as analyze_definition
decided in F1: same as validate_protocol_draft; the two tools render one analysis for two audiences
decided in F1: host affordance, not a capability; the catalog a host mounts and publishes into is local to its process, and publish_protocol_definition is how a definition crosses surfaces
host-process affordance: in-memory definitions exist only inside the host
